format: C# / ASP.NET Web Forms (code-behind for an .aspx page)
description: This file contains server-side logic for the ExamResult web page of an online examination system. It handles page load events to retrieve and update user exam data, and manages navigation between pages via button click handlers.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult.aspx ASP.NET Web Form page, managing user exam results and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial loading of the page, retrieves user exam data from session and database, updates records, and displays exam details.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Home button click, navigates to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Profile button click, navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Leaderboard button click, navigates to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Logout button click, navigates to the login page.
